title: Ceadir-Basket Pull Away Late to Win the Moldovan Championship
description: Ceadir-Basket are the champions of Moldova. The side from Ceadir-Lunga broke open a tight contest with a dominant fourth quarter to beat Gloria 107-87 in the National Division final at the Complex Sportiv ASEM, claiming the 2025-26 national men's title. For three quarters, the final was a genuine battle. Gloria edged the first quarter 22-21 and the teams stayed locked together through the second and third, with Ceadir-Basket holding only a slender 74-71 edge entering the final period. But the champions saved their best for last, outscoring Gloria 33-16 in the fourth quarter to turn a one-possession game into a comfortable 20-point victory.
imageCaption: Ceadir-Basket Pull Away Late to Win the Moldovan Championship (Photo: moldova.basketball)

title: Ceadir-Basket clinch 2024/25 title!
description: Ceadir-Basket clinched 2024/25 title in Moldova. They swept the Final series against Soroca 3-0. Ceadir-Basket closed the campaign with a final 95-75 win. They started with a 27-14 run and dominated the whole game. Denis Savca (190-G/F-1999) led the way with 22 points and Nicolae Grubii (178-PG-2000) nailed 11.

title: ASEM celebrate 2023/24 title!
description: ASEM celebrated 2023/24 title in Moldova. They swept the Final series against Balti 3-0. The last game was not played as the opponents did not have enough players in the roster to start the game. Alexandr Popov was named MVP of the Finals. Nicolae Grubii (178-PG-2000) received best defender award.

title: SS1 earn Superleague title
description: SS1 - Ceadir-Lunga 111-77 SS1 have been crowned Superleague champions. They crushed Ceadir-Lunga 111-77 in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep. Vitali Golodniy (195-F-1985) posted 24 points, 11 rebounds and 8 assists to lead the champions. SS1 went on a massive 61-33 second half run to ice the win. Vadim Bychkov (203-C-1999) delivered 23 points in the victory. Alexandr Guboglo answered with 21 points and 9 assists for Ceadir-Lunga.

title: Basco celebrate League title
description: Basco are 2020/21 champions. They beat SS1 in the title game to capture the trophy. Speranca earned the Bronze medals. They edged BAM Basket 75-72 in the consolation final. Vadim Bicicov (203-C-99) was trumped the MVP.

title: Gamma Cahul celebrate League title
description: Gamma Cahul celebrated 2020 League title. They beat Basco Balti 69-66 in the championship game. Mihail Miseailo (183-PG-02) came up with 17 points and 10 rebounds to lead the winners. Gamma recorded a 24-16 lead after ten minutes. Basco turned things around in the next two periods to eke out a 52-50 lead at the final intermission. But Gamma used a 19-14 run in the fourth quarter to triumph in the League. Serghei Epifanov (95) netted 16 points for the champions. Vladimir Gaicean (202-C-95) answered with 19 points and 9 rebounds for Basco Balti.
imageCaption: Gamma Cahul celebrate League title (Photo: Facebook)
